backend/main.mo: Motoko actor defining data types and initial seed data for a medical education app, including subject categories (First Year, Community Medicine, AETCOM) with modules, timetable entries, and class types.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping two features—adding Community Medicine to the Dashboard SubjectStatsCard and ensuring it appears in Records/Analytics filters—to their respective source files and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: A JSON document summarizing each frontend source file's purpose, covering data models, IndexedDB storage, domain logic, React hooks, utilities, routing, and all page/component files for the MedAttend Pro app.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS entry point defining CSS custom properties for light and dark theme color tokens (background, foreground, primary, chart colors, sidebar, etc.).
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the MedAttend Pro PWA, setting viewport meta, theme color, manifest link, app icon, and mounting the React app via the root div.
frontend/public/manifest.webmanifest: PWA web manifest for MedAttend Pro defining app name, display mode, theme/background colors, orientation, and a single 1024×1024 maskable icon.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component that wraps the TanStack Router provider inside a DbInitGate to ensure IndexedDB is ready before rendering, with initialization logging.
frontend/src/components/AppLayout.tsx: Main layout component that applies dark mode to the document root based on user settings and renders the page outlet above a fixed BottomNav.
frontend/src/components/attendance/Class: A card UI for a single ClassLog entry displaying subject, type, optional topic, time/duration, attendance badge, and Present/Absent action buttons.
frontend/src/components/attendance/Conse: Renders a single timetable period directly or groups multiple consecutive periods under a collapsible header showing combined time range and total duration.
frontend/src/components/BottomNav.tsx: Fixed bottom navigation bar with six icon-labeled links (Dashboard, Add Class, Timetable, Records, Analytics, Settings) that highlights the active route.
frontend/src/components/DbInitGate.tsx: Gate component that initializes IndexedDB before rendering children, showing a loading spinner during init and an error/timeout screen with retry functionality if initialization fails within 15 seconds.
frontend/src/components/MonthlySummaryCa: Card component that filters class logs to the current month and displays total conducted, attended, and overall attendance percentage for that month.
frontend/src/components/NextClassCard.ts: Displays the next upcoming class by scanning today's remaining entries and future days, showing subject, type, day, time range, and optional duration.
frontend/src/components/RecordDetailShee: A bottom/modal sheet for viewing and editing a single ClassLog record, supporting attendance status, topic, start time, and duration with auto-calculated end time.
frontend/src/components/SubjectStatsCard: Renders per-subject attendance statistics for Theory and Practical (with AETCOM breakdown), including percentage, classes attended/conducted, deficit, and safe-miss counts.
frontend/src/components/timetable/Timeta: Modal dialog component for adding or editing timetable entries, supporting subject/type selection, duration input, start/end time calculation, and AETCOM-specific UI hints.
Weekly timetable grid component that displays scheduled entries grouped by day (Monday–Saturday) with time range, duration, and edit/delete actions.
frontend/src/components/TodaySchedule.ts: Shows today's timetable entries grouped into consecutive class blocks, allowing the user to mark attendance as Present or Absent for each entry.
frontend/src/domain/attendanceRules.ts: Defines attendance thresholds (75% Theory, 80% Practical) and functions to calculate per-subject attendance stats and aggregate stats across all subjects.
frontend/src/domain/eligibilityMath.ts: Provides math utilities to calculate how many consecutive classes a student must attend to meet a threshold, and how many classes they can safely miss while staying above it.
frontend/src/domain/groupConsecutiveTime: Groups consecutive timetable entries sharing the same subject and type into merged time blocks, using duration or end-time matching to detect adjacency.
frontend/src/domain/statusColor.ts: Maps an attendance percentage against a threshold to a green/yellow/red status color and a corresponding human-readable label (Safe/Borderline/Shortage).
frontend/src/domain/subjects.ts: Defines the 1st-year MBBS subject list with their allowed session types and provides helpers to retrieve types per subject and map session types to Theory or Practical attendance categories.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React hook that creates and caches an ICP backend actor (anonymous or authenticated) using React Query, and invalidates dependent queries whenever the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides an InternetIdentityProvider context and useInternetIdentity hook that manage DFINITY AuthClient lifecycle, login/logout flow, and identity persistence across page reloads.
frontend/src/hooks/useLocalStore.ts: Provides React hooks (useClassLogs, useTimetable, useSettings) that wrap IndexedDB storage operations with reactive state and a simple in-memory event emitter for cross-component updates.
frontend/src/index.css: Global CSS file that sets up Tailwind directives and defines CSS custom properties for a medical blue-and-white theme in both light and dark modes.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that mounts the React app with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider wrappers.
frontend/src/pages/AddClassPage.tsx: Form page for manually adding one or multiple class log entries, supporting subject/type selection, time/duration fields, AETCOM toggling, and partial attendance tracking.
frontend/src/pages/AnalyticsPage.tsx: Analytics page that displays subject-wise theory/practical/AETCOM attendance bar charts and a monthly attendance trend for the last six months.
frontend/src/pages/DashboardPage.tsx: Main dashboard page showing a hero image, today's schedule, next class card, monthly summary, and per-subject attendance stat cards for all four MBBS subjects.
frontend/src/pages/RecordsPage.tsx: Records page that lists all class logs with filters for subject, type, date range, and topic search, and opens a detail sheet for editing or deleting individual entries.
frontend/src/pages/SettingsPage.tsx: Settings page component that allows toggling dark mode, auto-mark present, and auto-create from timetable options, and provides CSV/PDF export buttons for attendance data.
frontend/src/pages/TimetablePage.tsx: Timetable page that displays a weekly grid of schedule entries and supports adding, editing, and deleting timetable entries via a dialog.
frontend/src/router.tsx: Defines the TanStack Router configuration with routes for Dashboard, Add Class, Timetable, Records, Analytics, and Settings pages under a shared AppLayout root.
frontend/src/storage/db.ts: IndexedDB wrapper that initializes and manages the database with stores for class logs, timetable, and settings, including schema upgrade and v1-to-v2 migration logic.
frontend/src/storage/models.ts: Defines core TypeScript interfaces and types for ClassLog, TimetableEntry, Settings, and AttendanceStats, including subject/type unions and attendance status literals.
frontend/src/utils/exportCsv.ts: Utility that converts an array of ClassLog records into a CSV file and triggers a browser download.
frontend/src/utils/exportPdf.ts: Utility that generates an HTML attendance summary table from AttendanceStats and opens a print dialog in a new window for PDF export.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration with dark mode support, custom OKLCH-based design tokens for colors, border radius, animations, and plugins for typography, container queries, and animate.
project_state.json: Project state metadata tracking existing features, pending action requests, and known issues related to Community Medicine not appearing across dashboard, records, analytics, and add-class sections.
